name: Azure SQL Database
line: Run managed SQL Server databases with vector search and job scheduling.

free.text: 100K vCore seconds, 32 GB data/backups; pauses after 15 idle minutes

cells.metered: Basic from $0.161/day; serverless billed by use
cells.regions: Azure regions; options vary by region

sql.math: 730 hours ÷ 24 gives the number of days, then × $0.161 a day. That is $4.897... before rounding to $4.90. Tax is not included.
Idle database within the monthly data and backup limits. Covered compute can pause when unused, so the cost can be $0.

jobs.math: 730 hours × $0.031 an hour. Metadata and target databases are billed separately.
